The 2026 Memorial Day sales at Amazon and Best Buy are now live, and today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break deals are ready too. Headliners include this giant $400 price drop hitting this 1TB M3 iPad Air alongside all four colors on Apple’s new mid-range 256GB M4 iPad Air at $110 off and a new all-time low on this nano-texture 1TB M5 iPad Pro at $200 off. We also have the most accessible M5 MacBook Pro models now at $1,499 all-time lows – 16GB/1TB or 24GB/512GB joined by all 15-inch M5 MacBook Air models at $150 off via Amazon ahead of Memorial Day. In case you missed it yesterday, the now live Nintendo Switch 2: Choose Your Game console bundle deal might be the best deal we will see all year. Head below for a closer look.

Now even lower: Giant $400 price drop hits this 1TB M3 iPad Air today

We did catch the return of all-time low pricing this week on some of the more affordable M4 iPad Air models Apple released a couple months back. But stock is starting to run low on the perfectly capable M3 iPad Air clearance deals, and Amazon just dropped the prices again on select models – this 11-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell 1TB is a giant $400 off the list price, for example.

There are a few notable M3 iPad Air clearance deals still popping and we wanted to get them front and center before stock has completely depleted and now that pricing has dropped even lower on some of them:

  • 11-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell 512GB $749 (Reg. $1,049) – new Amazon all-time low
  • 11-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell 1TB $849 (Reg. $1,249) – new Amazon all-time low
  • 13-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell 1TB $1,149 (Reg. $1,449) – new Amazon all-time low

All three of those offers are very notable, but that 11-inch Wi-Fi + Cell 1TB is of particular interest. We are talking about an originally $1,249 configuration at $849 shipped here. That’s $400 off the original list and the best deal we have ever tracked at Amazon.

The new 11-inch M4 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell with the 1TB storage capacity carries the same $1,249 list price the M3 did and is currently on sale for $1,169 at Amazon. That’s $80 off and the lowest price we have tracked at Amazon to date.

The new M4 model certainly has some upgrades, but I think for most folks the M3 is just as capable in terms of day-to-day use, and these fleeting clearance deals are a great way to secure an upgraded machine for dramatically less cash.

All four colors on Apple’s new mid-range 256GB M4 iPad Air are back to all-time low pricing at $110 off

This nano-texture 1TB M5 iPad Pro just hit its best Amazon price ever at $200 off

Most accessible M5 MacBook Pro models now at $1,499 all-time lows: 16GB/1TB or 24GB/512GB

The most affordable and accessible point of entry into the latest M5 MacBook Pro lineup is on sale right now. Amazon has the 16GB/1TB model down at the $1,499 all-time low ($200 off the list price) and B&H has this 24GB/512GB model Apple doesn’t sell anymore at the same price. Details below.

Apple got rid if the 512GB storage tier on the current-gen M5 MacBook Pro in March. This leaves the 16GB/1TB as the new entry point, but there are still some 512GB models floating around out there with some solid deals:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,499 (Reg. $1,699, Orig. $1,799)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/512GB $1,499 (Reg. Orig. $1,799)

Amazon is currently offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB of RAM and the new base 1TB storage capacity down at $1,499 shipped in Space Black. This is a regularly $1,699 machine that started life at $1,799 in late 2025 and is now sitting down at the lowest price we have ever tracked on Amazon.

B&H, however, still has some stock left on the 512GB models and is offering a configuration with 24GB of RAM at the same $1,499 shipped right now. Previous to Apple configuring the storage tiers on the M5 machines, this was a $1,799 machine.

I, as I have said many a time, much prefer to pay for the RAM over the storage, and this has me leaning towards the B&H offer. That said, Apple clearly thinks 512GB of storage is a thing of the past on the Pro machines, and I’m starting to as well.

M5 MacBook Pro

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,500 (Reg. $1,699)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,749 (Reg. $1,899) – $150 less at B&H
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 32GB/1TB $1,799 (Reg. $2,099) – New all-time low

M5 Pro MacBook Pro

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,999 (Reg. $2,199)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,600 (Reg. $2,799) – Amazon all-time low
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,450 (Reg. $2,699) – New all-time low
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,850 (Reg. $3,099) – $50 less at B&H

All 15-inch M5 MacBook Air models are $150 off at Amazon ahead of Memorial Day

The deals on the new 13-inch M5 MacBook Air are all but entirely gone now. There are some price drops there, but noting nearly as good as the sweeping $150 off we featured over the last month. We are indeed hoping they return for Memorial Day proper, but folks looking towards the larger 15-inch display display are in luck – just about every color and config Amazon carries is $150 off right now.

Amazon is now offering $150 off the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air for those looking to upgrade to Apple’s larger form-factor right now:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,549 (Reg. $1,699)

These deals land on par with the best prices we have tracked since release in March and make for a notable opportunity to upgrade ahead of summer 2026. There is, of course, a chance we see these same machines at closer to $200 off for Black Friday or something along those lines, but if you’re looking for a new machine now, $150 off the brand new M5 machines not much more than two months after release is a solid discount for sure.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 up to $188 off via Amazon Resale today

Even still, after over 6 months on the market, deals on Apple Watch Ultra 3 have been far and few between. We have caught a couple notable chances to land select models at $99 off in new condition, but today we have spotted a few Like New Amazon Resale listings with bonus 10% coupons delivering as much as $188 off the new list prices. Stock is low here, so you’ll want to check them out sooner than later if you’re interested.

***Note: All of the listings below will drop an additional 10% in the cart

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Alpine Loop $619 (Reg. $799 new)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Light Blue Alpine Loop $611 (Reg. $799 new)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Milanese Loop $689 (Reg. $899 new)

There are several Apple Watch Ultra 3 units receiving this bonus 10% off at checkout right now, so you’ll want to double check the configuration you’re after – head over to the new Apple Watch Ultra 3 Amazon listing, and on the right hand side scroll down to the “Used – Like New” section just below the Add to Cart button.

Again, deals on new condition Ultra 3 units have been mostly hard to come by thus far. There is a chance we see the return of the $99 price drops (and hopefully even better than that) in the coming months, but at this point it looks like retailers are keeping the deals in and around that range whenever they do go on sale.

As of right now, even some of the better Best Buy open-box unit deals we were tracking earlier this year have jumped up much closer to full price than we would like to see. But this black model with the Milanese Loop is a notable $149 off right now:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 + Milanese Loop $750 (Reg. $899)

Amazon will have the new MacBook Neo delivered to you as soon as tomorrow from $590

While Apple has managed to bring the delivery wait times down on the new more affordable MacBook Neo to some degree, it will still take a week or two on most models. Amazon is still much faster and with a lower price – they start from $590 and deliver as soon as tomorrow.

  • MacBook Neo Citrus 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery in 2 days
  • MacBook Neo Citrus 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Silver 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Silver 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by Friday
  • MacBook Neo Indigo 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Indigo 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Blush 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery in 2 days
  • MacBook Neo Blush 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow

As of right now, Apple is still listing most MacBook Neo configs with a 1 to 2 week delivery time, and of course all at full price.

While Amazon’s “deals” are really nothing at just $10 off, considering how much faster it can deliver MacBook Neo to your doorstep, its seems a like no brainer option. Unless you have some Apple store credit or something, Amazon can have your new Neo to you as fast as tomorrow with almost every option delivering by Thursday of this week at the time of writing. These deliver times do bounce around quite a bit, but Amazon is clearly getting this thing out the door a whole lot quicker.
